title: DHIS2 export reads the wrong Bikram Sambat month when month_start_date is not 1
problem: CHT issue #11342 reports that with Bikram Sambat reporting months enabled and month_start_date not equal to 1, DHIS2 target export can read an adjacent target month or zero because the export key derives from the raw selected date rather than the reporting interval used by target writers.
humanitarian_relevance: Target exports can feed health program reporting and supervision workflows. Incorrect month aggregation could misstate operational performance for Nepali-language deployments, but Humanifest should not overclaim patient outcome impact from this issue alone.

evidence.claim: Issue author reports a local 5.2.0 reproduction where an August 2026 export returned the BS 2083-04 total rather than the stored 2083-05 total.

Read-only source inspection confirmed api/src/services/export/dhis.js targetDocsInMonth builds the BS key from moment(timestamp), while webapp and rules-engine paths use interval end dates for target tags.
On 2026-09-08, read-only GitHub issue metadata reported OPEN, no assignees, 0 comments, and updatedAt 2026-08-26T10:20:43Z. This does not establish maintainer availability or reproducibility.

At the inspected commit, api/tests/mocha/services/export/dhis.spec.js contains Bikram Sambat export coverage with an explicit month_start_date of 1; no non-default month_start_date case was found in that file. Tests were read, not executed.
At the inspected commit, targetDocsInMonth derives the Bikram Sambat lookup month from moment(timestamp), and the caller passes the selected from date.

code_surface: medic/cht-core: api/src/services/export/dhis.js and api/tests/mocha/services/export/dhis.spec.js, inspected at commit 35b2bb6dac0844bee3228476591d08d56c5dd10d.
proposed_change: After maintainer confirmation, derive the target-doc lookup key from the same reporting interval semantics used by the writer, and add a regression test for use_bikram_sambat_months with non-default month_start_date.
tests: Add a focused regression in api/tests/mocha/services/export/dhis.spec.js for non-default Bikram Sambat month_start_date while preserving existing Gregorian/default-day behavior. Existing explicit month_start_date coverage uses 1. The package script is npm run unit-api; no CHT tests or setup scripts were run in this recheck.
environment: Tier 1 for source inspection; Tier 3 Codespaces/devcontainer recommended before implementation because cht-core is large and uses multiple package workspaces, CouchDB-related services, and project-controlled npm scripts.
maintainer: No maintainer has confirmed desired approach for this issue yet; inquiry should ask whether the interval-derived lookup and period-label semantics are the preferred direction.
risks: Medium: date/calendar reporting semantics are consequential and cross-system with DHIS2. Risk of a technically simple patch that encodes the wrong product decision.
